# TRL-PARSE-0013: Insertion directive is out of place

- Severity: error
- Exit class: error
- Area: PARSE
- Since: 0.1.0
- Status: active

## Remediation

Place elseif and else directly after an if or elseif directive, and give each directive a body.

## Example

```json
{"code": "TRL-PARSE-0013", "severity": "error", "params": {"directive": "<directive>"}}
```
